# Law Offices of Robin D. Perry & Associates

> > Southern California law firm serving Long Beach, Bellflower, Lakewood, and surrounding communities with personal injury and criminal defense representation.

Robin D. Perry & Associates provides legal services across Los Angeles County with over 25 years of experience handling personal injury claims (car accidents, rideshare incidents, dog bites) and criminal defense matters (DUI, drug crimes, domestic violence, sex crimes). The firm serves multiple cities including Long Beach, Bellflower, Norwalk, Whittier, Lakewood, Carson, Cerritos, Downey, and San Pedro.
